title: one-shot NON capability re-announce has no recovery when the datagram is lost
description: Security review of 99sg.2 (pass 2, finding 3): node.py drains take_root_changes() before transmission and a send() failure only logs; the NON is never retransmitted and the ~200B announcement fits one frame so SCHC fragment ARQ does not apply. spec/06-security.md:1046-1048 MUSTs re-announce after root change; a jammed/lost single datagram leaves the new root's capability table permanently missing the node until the next root-change event. Needs bounded retry, a refresh trigger (spec 8.12 lists approaching-expiry refresh), or explicit best-effort sign-off.
